description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Edgar], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Edgar
description.text: Poison/Fire/Lightning abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999, ranged. Grants [Poison, Fire, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Poison, Fire, Lightning Ability DEF and RES 40% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Dualcast Poison, Fire, Lightning (Tactical) 5] to user if Level 2+ EnPoison or EnFire or EnLightning, grants [Attach Poison 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] to user if not.
